population: B2B clean-train folds0-3 (1421 queries); fold4=611, B2B581, internal300, development, confirmation sealed
schedule_origin: Quality schedule is the previously frozen C0/fixed-depth-10 control. Other two are prespecified monotone sensitivity points using only previously examined depths; no schedule is selected from A2 outcomes.
edit_family: V8/STAY plus every distinct permutation reachable by at most two adjacent transpositions (Kendall inversion distance <=2); exactly one full 12-packet order per query and schedule
primary_oracle: Choose per query from candidate orders with no attainable-anchor success breaks and cumulative context tokens <= same-query V8; maximize number of repaired anchors, then minimize cumulative tokens, prefer STAY on exact ties, then lexicographically smallest order. STAY always feasible.
secondary_oracle: Quality-first no-break oracle: maximize repaired anchors, then minimize cumulative tokens without a baseline cost constraint; prefer STAY on exact ties and report token increase when applicable.
metrics: All attainable-anchor successes, Complete, paired repairs/breaks, cumulative context tokens, normalized mean cumulative context fraction, and both-success paired token delta. Width-three is descriptive only.
interpretation: Fixed stopping removes per-query stopping hindsight, but choosing a local edit using exact outcomes is still a per-query oracle upper bound, not a deployable policy. Train1421 is design-exposed.
